compare.previewMissing: Preview not found — run the test again.
compare.hintZoomed: Drag the image to pan · Shift-drag to compare · wheel = zoom · double-click to reset.
compare.hintNotZoomed: Drag the handle to compare · wheel = zoom · double-click to zoom in on a spot.

modelHint.rife-v4.6: Latest general-purpose version included by the official repository.
modelHint.animesr: Anime 4× for video — remembers the previous frame, so less flicker.
modelHint.aniscale2: Anime 2× — cleans up compression in WEB and DVD sources.
modelHint.figsr: Anime 2× — a different method; compare it on your shot.
modelHint.shufflespan: Anime 2× — processes the image in 1080p tiles.
modelHint.ntire-span: Live action 4×, sharp source — the baseline of the group.
modelHint.ntire-pds: Live action 4×, sharp source — fast and tiny.
modelHint.ntire-zenosr: Live action 4×, sharp source — the smallest, but slow.
modelHint.ntire-haesr: Live action 4×, sharp source — the most faithful, but slow.
modelHint.ntire-rfdn-span: Live action 4×, sharp source — heavier than SPAN, with no visible gain.
modelHint.ntire-hfenet: Live action 4×, sharp source — keeps detail well, slower.
modelHint.ntire-vscinet: Live action 4×, sharp source — very compact, but slow.
modelHint.ntire-dscf: Live action 4×, sharp source — like SPAN, a bit faster.
modelHint.ntire-pkdsr: Live action 4×, sharp source — fast and light.
modelHint.ntire-amcanet: Live action 4×, sharp source — compact, good detail.
modelHint.ntire-disp: Live action 4×, sharp source — the fastest of the group.
modelHint.ntire-bviesr: Live action 4×, sharp source — compact, built for speed.
modelHint.ntire-errn2: Live action 4×, sharp source — between speed and detail.
modelHint.ntire-safmn: Live action 4×, sharp source — the slowest of the group.
modelHint.tas-anime1080fixer: Anime 1× — fixes encoding flaws, keeps fine detail.
modelHint.tas-deh264-span: Anime 1× — removes H.264 blocks and smears.
modelHint.tas-real-plksr: 1× — removes JPEG artifacts and ringing around edges.

shaderHint.rtx_vsr: Live action and anime — fixed 2×, NVIDIA.

errors.frameBlack: Frame is nearly black (fade?) — move the playhead and test again.
errors.invalidRange: The end must come after the start.
errors.duplicateOutputNames: Several sources would produce the same name. Export them separately.
